Application Data.NAME: Stonehaven Memorials, Inc.
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Stonehaven Memorials, Inc. engages in the sale and installation of high-quality granite and marble monuments and tombstones. Our operations include sourcing materials from approved quarries, which ensures consistent quality and minimizes risks associated with premature defects. We follow strict safety protocols during installation, utilizing trained professionals and approved equipment to prevent accidents and maintain standards. Customer service is prioritized, with a focus on providing personalized memorial solutions while ensuring secure transportation and installation processes. Additionally, we have implemented security measures at our premises to mitigate theft and vandalism risks, allowing us to operate in compliance with industry standards and regulations.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 02/15/2023, we experienced an incident of vandalism resulting in damage to three granite monuments. The total estimated cost for repairs was $5,000. The claim has been filed and is currently pending assessment by our insurer.
Application Data.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Metal fencing and security cameras installed around the premises; watchpersons on site during business hours.
